title: Expose supported agent runtime lifecycle APIs
description:
As a runtime integrator, I want supported configuration, observability, serialization, and prewarming APIs, so that applications can integrate without replacing private Tactus methods.

Feature: Supported agent runtime lifecycle

Scenario: Prewarm model infrastructure
Given an agent model configuration
When the runtime prewarms it without inference
Then model imports and adapter construction complete before the first turn
And no provider request is sent

Scenario: Observe model lifecycle
Given an agent turn
When it prepares and streams a model response
Then supported lifecycle events identify preparation, LM initialization, request dispatch, first chunk, and completion

Scenario: Configure request timeout
Given an agent request timeout
When a streaming or non-streaming turn runs
Then the scoped language model receives that timeout

Scenario: Serialize runtime events
Given a Pydantic runtime event
When Json.encode serializes it
Then valid JSON is returned without consumer patches.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: All specified runtime lifecycle behaviors are implemented and verified.
